story.titleZh: 拉塞尔因罚退无缘杆位，放弃最快圈仍感刺痛
story.summaryZh: 拉塞尔在因罚退五位而无法从杆位起步的情况下，仍在雨中的英特拉格斯排位赛中放弃了一圈本可能最快的圈速，这让他感到格外受伤。
story.originalTitle: Why Russell's 'pole' was lost either way - and it hurt like hell
story.summaryEn: George Russell was already set to miss out on pole position due to a five-place grid penalty, yet abandoning a lap that could have been quickest in the wet Interlagos qualifying session left him feeling unusually hurt.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔知道自己因罚退无法从2026年巴西大奖赛的杆位起步，但即便如此，错失最快圈速仍让他感到格外受伤。
拉塞尔在延迟的雨中英特拉格斯排位赛结束后确信，他的梅赛德斯F1车队让他放弃了一圈“肯定”会是最快的圈速。
这种确信可以理解，但可能过于乐观。由于五位罚退，他本来就不会从杆位起步；但即便他不放弃，他也注定会错失最快圈，因为那一圈几乎肯定会被他的好友亚历山大·阿尔本无意中影响。
然而，真正让拉塞尔如此受伤的，是更深层东西的失去——在一个曾寄予厚望却令人失望的赛季中，一次罕见的明显优势时刻。
拉塞尔的比赛工程师马库斯·达德利建议他收油的唯一原因是，拉塞尔已经追上了阿尔本的威廉姆斯赛车——拉塞尔甚至抱怨阿尔本在单圈中途挡了他的路。
虽然拉塞尔看起来确实有望完成一个比最终杆位得主兰多·诺里斯更快的单圈，因为他在放弃该圈时至少快了百分之几秒，但这依赖于他在完成该圈时拥有畅通无阻的赛道，而拉塞尔本不会拥有这样的条件。
拉塞尔与阿尔本的距离足够近，以至于他已经连续三个迷你赛段比上一圈更慢。他可能会在中段末尾的左手11号弯受到干扰，随后是通往终点线长上坡的容桑左弯，以及进入起终点直道的弯角。
梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫表示，拉塞尔“当时比诺里斯略快一点，但正在追上阿尔本，我们认为他即将损失时间”。而这一威胁是真实存在的。
即使阿尔本以比第一轮通过最后赛段更快的速度完成了那一圈，他也会比拉塞尔和诺里斯能做出的成绩慢上零点几秒。
实际情况是，阿尔本在进入茹桑库弯时严重锁死，损失了大量时间，但没有冲出赛道，这意味着他最好的情况是在出弯时挡住拉塞尔，让梅赛德斯赛车通过，或者更可能的是，完全挡住拉塞尔的路线。
无论哪种情况，拉塞尔都会被限制在阿尔本的峰值速度或他降低后的速度之内——这两种情况都无法让拉塞尔足够快地完成那一圈以击败诺里斯。
同样值得指出的是，拉塞尔那句“移动啊阿尔博诺！”的无线电消息，才是促使达德利开始讨论放弃该圈的关键触发点。
也许梅赛德斯无论如何都会介入。但拉塞尔一定知道阿尔本极有可能毁掉这一圈，否则他就不会表达自己的不满。
所以，在某种程度上，他会意识到那一圈非常好的成绩正在溜走。正如赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林所指出的，如果拉塞尔完成该圈并被阻挡，继续行驶会“有风险危及那一圈和下一圈”。
沃尔夫表示，“事后看来，考虑到下一圈会下雨，我们应该继续跑，但事后说这话很容易”——这在一定程度上适用，因为他们至少可以或应该尝试完成该圈，但这可能并未改变结果。
真正的不幸最终是与阿尔本距离过近，而不是梅赛德斯如何处理此事。
从拉塞尔的无线电通话、他在赛后封闭区接受电视采访时的初步评论，到最后的官方新闻发布会，他的沮丧程度已经完整地展现出来。
当沃尔夫试图在无线电中安抚拉塞尔不断上升的怒火，说“乔治，你是第二名”时，你几乎能听到拉塞尔在回复时努力消化自己的懊恼：“是啊，但是……第二名。我不想当第二名，我想当第一名。那一圈本该是第一名的圈速。”
“天哪！”
在输给安东内利、无缘冠军的过程中，拉塞尔有过不少出色的排位赛表现，即便在较弱的周末，他也常常能把自己拉回竞争行列。
拉塞尔在2026款赛车上常常缺乏自然的感觉，有时就是对它信心不足。即便他曾经接近安东内利或略微领先，对他来说也从来不像安东内利状态好时那样轻松。
在巴西的干地练习中，他似乎又一次落后于安东内利，但下雨之后情况就变了。这正变成少数几次他干脆利落地成为更快的梅赛德斯车手的情况之一，看起来他拥有澳大利亚、西班牙、阿塞拜疆那种掌控力。
所以，尽管他本来保不住杆位，尽管这仅仅改变了他从第六还是第七位起步，拉塞尔真的很想要这个。
无论这是为了他自己、为了向外界展示些什么，或许甚至是为了某种内在的东西，这都会是他自身出色巅峰状态的有力信号——而此时此刻，所有焦点都集中在安东内利的冠军、安东内利的才华，以及拉塞尔那种坏运气与短板交织的处境上。
拉塞尔说：“显然，从车队方面来说，我们本周末有一个目标，那就是赢得总冠军，这非常符合车队每个人的目标。”
“对我个人而言，考虑到上周的情况，今天拿到杆位对我来说意义重大。”
“上周我以九毫秒之差错过了杆位，但那真是一个惊喜。今天，我真的感觉我跑的每一圈，在我完成的大多数圈数里我都排在榜首。”
“所以，我对最终的结果真的非常非常失望。”
detailEn: George Russell knew he would not start the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix from pole position due to a grid penalty, yet missing out on being quickest left him feeling unusually hurt regardless.
Russell ended the delayed, wet Interlagos qualifying session convinced his Mercedes Formula 1 team had made him abandon a lap that was “definitely” going to be quickest.

That certainty was understandable, but probably overzealous. He would never have started from pole anyway, thanks to his five-place grid drop, but he was poised to miss out regardless of backing off because the lap was almost certainly about to be inadvertently compromised by Russell’s good friend Alex Albon.
What hurt Russell so much, though, was the loss of something deeper – a rare moment of obvious superiority in a season that promised so much and yet has been so disappointing.

The only reason Russell’s race engineer Marcus Dudley advised him to back off was because Russell had caught Alex Albon’s Williams – and Russell had even complained about Albon being in his way in the middle of the lap.

While Russell did seem to be on his way to completing a faster lap than eventual polesitter Lando Norris, as he was at least a few hundredths quicker at the moment he aborted, that relies on a clear run to end the lap that Russell would not have had.

Russell was close enough to Albon that he had already posted three mini-sectors in a row slower than his previous lap. He would have potentially been disturbed through the left-hand Turn 11 at the end of the middle sector, then the Juncao left-hander that leads to the long, uphill run to the finish line, and the kink onto the start-finish straight.
Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said Russell was “very slightly up on Norris at that point but was catching Albon and we thought was about to lose time”. And the threat was real.
Even if Albon completed the lap he was on at an improved pace compared to his first run through the final sector, he would be several tenths slower than what Russell and Norris could do.

As it was, Albon had a major lock-up into Juncao that cost him a load of time, but did not send him off-track, making it likely he would have at best held Russell up on the exit as the Mercedes went by or, probably more likely, got in Russell’s way completely.
Either way, Russell would have been contained at Albon’s peak pace or his reduced pace – neither of which would have let Russell finish the lap quickly enough to beat Norris.
It’s also worth pointing out that Russell’s “move Albono!” radio message was the trigger for Dudley to even initiate talk of aborting the lap in question.
Perhaps Mercedes would have interjected anyway. But Russell must have known that Albon was at serious risk of ruining the lap otherwise he would not have expressed his frustration.

So, on some level, he would have known that very good lap was slipping away. And as trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin pointed out, continuing would “risk compromising both that lap and the next” if Russell had completed the lap and been baulked.

Wolff said that “in hindsight, with the rain coming on the next lap, we should have kept going but it is very easy to say this after the event” – which applies insofar as they could or should have at least tried to finish the lap, but it probably did not change the outcome.
The real misfortune was ultimately the proximity to Albon, rather than how Mercedes handled it.

Between Russell’s in-car radio messages, his initial comments on television during the parc ferme interviews post-session, and finally the official press conference, the magnitude of his frustration became fully formed.

When Wolff tried to soothe Russell’s rising anger over the radio with “George you’re P2”, you could almost hear Russell trying to process his own annoyance as he replied: ““Yeah but…P2. I don’t wanna be P2, I want to be P1. That was a P1 lap.
“F*****g hell!”
Russell’s had plenty of good qualifying performances through his championship defeat to Kimi Antonelli, as even on weaker weekends he’s often been able to haul himself into contention.

Russell has often lacked a natural feeling in the 2026 car, and sometimes just not had enough confidence in it. Even when he’s been close to Antonelli or marginally ahead, it has never looked as easy for him as when Antonelli’s on form.

He also seemed to be trailing Antonelli yet again in the dry in practice in Brazil, but when the rain came the situation changed. This was turning into one of the few occasions where he has just been emphatically the faster Mercedes driver and looked like he had an Australia/Spain/Azerbaijan-type control.
So, regardless of the fact he would not have kept pole, regardless of how it only changed whether he starts sixth or seventh, Russell really wanted this.

Whether it was for himself, something to show the outside world, or maybe even something internal, it would have been a strong signal of his own brilliant peak, at a time when all the focus has been on Antonelli’s title, Antonelli’s brilliance, and Russell’s mix of bad luck and shortcomings.
“Obviously, from the team side, we've got one goal this weekend, which is to win the championship, and that's very much the goal of everyone within the team,” Russell said.
“For me personally, given the circumstances of last week, it would have meant a lot to me to take pole today.
“I missed it last week by nine milliseconds, but that was a real surprise. Today, I really felt every lap I was doing, I was top of the leaderboard most laps I completed.
“So, I'm really, really disappointed with how that panned out.”
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔的比赛工程师马库斯·达德利建议他放弃该圈，原因是他在圈中追上了亚历山大·阿尔本的威廉姆斯赛车
拉塞尔在放弃该圈时已连续三个迷你路段慢于自己上一圈，且他此前曾抱怨阿尔本挡路
拉塞尔认为那圈“肯定”会是最快圈，但文章指出这一判断可能过于乐观
keyPointsEn: Russell's race engineer Marcus Dudley advised him to back off because he had caught Alex Albon's Williams during the lap
Russell had already posted three consecutive mini-sectors slower than his previous lap when he aborted, and had earlier complained about Albon being in his way

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
